description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and max activation value for different configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at 200-unit intervals.  

A dashed blue line, labeled “attn_output”, starts at approximately 100 at a layer value of 0, remains relatively constant until layer 5 where it begins to increase, reaching approximately 500 at layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “attn_residual”, displays values close to zero between layers 0 and 5, then increases to approximately 300 by layer 21. A solid green line, labeled “ffn_output”, begins at approximately 100 at layer 0, sharply increases starting at layer 5 to approximately 1400 at layer 6, then remains relatively consistent until layer 18 where it declines to approximately 100 by layer 21. Finally, a solid red line, labeled “ffn_residual”, begins at approximately 20 at layer 0, rapidly increases starting at layer 5 to a value near 1500 at layer 6, remains near 1500 until layer 17, then rapidly decreases to approximately 20 by layer 21.
